description: Deep into jazz-rooted hip-hop: sample-flipped, head-nod boom-bap with real digging. Chill, relaxing, jazzy rap — experimental jazz-adjacent stuff and playlist filler miss the point.
notes: Focused single-lane profile: the test is subtlety WITHIN jazz-hip-hop (canon vs filler, digging depth, chill vs experimental), plus one clean novel bridge out of the lane. Reviewed with wyatt 2026-10-03: added jh-1 (Dilla 4★), jh-4 (Skyzoo 4★), jh-6 (Cosmogramma 2★ — the classic over-recommendation). The golden set (eval/golden/jazzy_hiphop.json) is the answer key and every entry in it must be inferable from these reviews.

reviews.text: Real digging, unfiltered. Chopped-up jazz and off-kilter drums, and it still relaxes me in a way almost nothing else does.
Melancholy head-nod. Perfect loops, real jazz chops under the rap. Makes me want to write stuff.
Common is cheesy as always, but great beats and vibes
Chill, jazzy rap that just lets you unwind. Warm loops and the raps sit right on top of them — this is the vibe I come home to.

reviews.text: Tribe at their best. Low Stakes but vibes
A lot of people recommend this and it's good music — but it isn't really hip-hop, and the experimental side never lets me relax the way the rest of this list does.
